name: Adaptive Control Model
task: Joint torque control of a cobot arm whose payload, joint friction and motor strength change during operation, with a learned dynamics residual that adapts at every control step

robot.description: KUKA kuka_robot_descriptions, package kuka_lbr_iisy_support, Apache-2.0, masses, inertias and limits as published

model.input: 24 values: sine and cosine of the joint angles, joint velocities and joint accelerations, normalised inside the model
model.head: head.npy, 32 × 6, residual torque in N·m, the starting point of adaptation

adaptation.method: Recursive least squares on the head, one covariance shared by all joints
adaptation.torque_alignment: applied torque delayed through the same filters as the acceleration estimate

control.law: computed torque on the nominal model, plus the residual evaluated on the reference path (desired compensation)

training.logs: 40 pick-and-place episodes per seed under computed torque on the nominal model, payload 0 to 4 kg, friction 0.7 to 1.3 times base, wear 0 to 15%
training.windows: 0.3 s to adapt on, 0.2 s to be scored on
training.error_units: mean squared error with each joint's residual divided by its spread

test.scenarios: 40 seeded pick-and-place episodes of 16 moves, 20 within the training range and 20 beyond it (payload 4 to 8 kg, friction 0.4 to 1.6 times base, wear 15 to 30%)
test.intervals: 95%, hierarchical bootstrap over seeds and scenarios
test.timing: median per control step on a laptop CPU, ONNX Runtime with one thread
